name: Execute source-derived two-order and multiplicative linear schema programs over original SignCell fibers

constraints: Do not change the Obsmetrologia generative order: Marks/Articulating before predications, positing, and all fiber operations.
Preserve distinct truth and knowledge orders, both positive and negative witness incidences, and linear multiplicative operations.
Never equate an enumerated family with all admissible causal descents, an application program with a schema validator, or a finite FOUR result with transfinite settlement.
Never let a schema grant native office, legal, payment, tool or effect powers.

An actual typed recursive schema program executes using canonical Data FOUR primitives and SignChain fiber functions.
A truth-order fusion/residual adjunction holds on all four FOUR points in executable tests; contradictions do not explode into unrelated facts.
The interpreter refuses forged frames, invalid operators, unenumerated families and unsupported transfinite regime declarations.
The immutable selected SignChain package is installed in a real downstream consumer, which independently exercises positive, different valid, and adverse cases.

Existing original fiber-program semantics pass while accessor/cyclic/executable syntax refuses before evaluation, with zero ordinary getter calls and unchanged owner-branded byte/bigint claim receiving.
